xml-to-excel.formula:
records = elements with the most common repeating tag.
columns = union of leaf child tag names, first-seen order.
cell type = Number if the value matches -?[0-9]+(.[0-9]+)?, otherwise String.
XML escaping: & -> &, < -> <, > -> > inside cell text.

xml-to-excel.workedExample:
XML:
<catalog>
  <book><title>Atomic Habits</title><author>James Clear</author><price>499</price></book>
  <book><title>Deep Work</title><author>Cal Newport</author><price>450</price></book>
</catalog>

1. Records: 2 <book> elements. Columns: title, author, price.
2. Header row: three String cells — title, author, price.
3. Row 1: "Atomic Habits" (String), "James Clear" (String), 499 (Number).
4. Row 2: "Deep Work" (String), "Cal Newport" (String), 450 (Number).
5. The .xls file opens in Excel with sortable numeric prices.
